class.name: FmodAudioEffectPhaser
class.brief_description: Phaser effect using a modulated chain of six all-pass filters.
class.description: FmodAudioEffectPhaser uses a custom DSP with six modulated all-pass stages per channel. The filtered signal is mixed with the original signal, and feedback controls the amount fed back through the filter chain. The modulation sweeps between [member range_min_hz] and [member range_max_hz] at [member rate_hz]. [member depth] controls the filtered signal level added to the original signal.

method.name: set_depth
method.description: Sets the filtered signal gain added to the original signal, clamped to 0.1 through 4.0.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns the filtered signal gain added to the original signal.

method.name: set_feedback
method.description: Sets the feedback amount. Range: 0.1 to 0.9. Higher feedback creates more resonant, intense phasing effects.

method.name: set_range_max_hz
method.description: Sets the maximum frequency of the LFO sweep in Hertz. Range: 10 to 10000.

method.name: get_range_max_hz
method.description: Returns the maximum frequency of the LFO sweep in Hertz.

method.name: set_range_min_hz
method.description: Sets the minimum frequency of the LFO sweep in Hertz. Range: 10 to 10000.

method.name: get_range_min_hz
method.description: Returns the minimum frequency of the LFO sweep in Hertz.

method.name: set_rate_hz
method.description: Sets the modulation rate in Hz, clamped to 0.01 through 20.0.

method.name: get_rate_hz
method.description: Returns the modulation rate in Hertz.

members.member: The gain of the filtered signal mixed with the original signal, clamped to 0.1 through 4.0. The default is 1.0. This controls effect intensity rather than the frequency sweep limits.
The feedback amount. Range: 0.1 to 0.9. Higher feedback creates more resonant, intense phasing effects.
The maximum frequency of the LFO sweep in Hz. Range: 10 to 10000.
The minimum frequency of the LFO sweep in Hz. Range: 10 to 10000.
The modulation rate in Hz, clamped to 0.01 through 20.0. The default is 0.5 Hz.
